basics.name: Jose Ramirez Mora
basics.label: Staff Engineer · product and platform
basics.summary: Staff engineer with 15+ years who owns product surfaces end to end and builds the platforms other teams depend on: frontend architecture, design systems, data access and release tooling. At Personio and DAZN I built design-system components and integration patterns that 4+ teams adopted, migrated five applications off a legacy monolith, moved a product domain's data access from legacy REST to the company GraphQL layer (5+ entities, 20+ endpoints retired), and cut p75 LCP 21% in production. Before that I designed a backend-for-frontend service and a logging library that became platform standards, and led full-stack teams for five years.
basics.tagline: Staff Engineer building frontend architecture, design systems, and developer experience at scale — turning sprawling, hard-to-change products into fast, reliable platforms teams enjoy building on.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Migrated my domain's data access off legacy REST onto the company-wide GraphQL layer: 5+ entities, 20+ endpoints retired, done incrementally alongside feature work with no dedicated project. Ended the dual data-access pattern that was driving architectural drift.
Cut p75 LCP 21% in real-user monitoring across high-traffic surfaces by eliminating unused JavaScript and redrawing bundle boundaries.
Defined and own the frontend integration model for company-wide groups management; shipped the first production use case to all customers; the pattern is now reused across 4+ product domains.
Driving the connection of design-system components directly to product-domain data sources, so teams reuse one integration instead of re-wiring it: less duplication, stale API usage and UX drift.

work.name: Personio
highlights: Led migration of 5+ applications off the legacy frontend monolith onto the modular stack, moving the domain from a slow, debt-accumulating codebase to one where features ship reliably.
Owned frontend delivery of the central UI rebrand for my domain: 12+ stakeholders coordinated, a full-domain release with parallel UI to guarantee parity at launch.
Designed reusable geolocation and mapping infrastructure (location services and UI components) used by multiple product teams without duplicating third-party integrations.
Established the recurring frontend architecture forum for cross-team alignment and less implementation drift.

work.name: DAZN
highlights: Designed and built governance tooling for the headless CMS architecture, letting multiple teams create and manage content models with consistent validation and version control.
Drove the landing-pages micro-frontend toward Server-Driven UI on Next.js, decoupling layout control from frontend release cycles.
Drove Design System adoption across 3+ frontend teams through guidance and code review: brand consistency, accessibility compliance, less per-team UI time.
Optimized monorepo CI and standardized cross-team library releases, cutting manual publishing errors and version drift.

work.name: DAZN
highlights: Led core design-system components and design tokens, establishing atomic component patterns adopted across web applications; standardized token naming.
Built shared internationalization utilities (dates, times, currencies) used across product surfaces.
Presented architecture proposals to the frontend guild and technical council.

work.name: Travix
highlights: Aligned frontend architecture across 4+ product teams, consolidating common patterns into shared libraries and cutting duplicated implementation.
Technically led a product team through development cycles; mentored engineers inside and outside the company.
Performance guild member, shaping the organisation's frontend strategy.

work.name: Travix
highlights: Designed the backend-for-frontend service that became the standard adopted across the platform.
Created the shared server- and client-side logging library that aligned logging standards company-wide.

work.name: Travix

work.name: First Factory

Built 0-to-1 prototypes for mobile and web products, taking several into React, Angular and Node.js production applications.
Contributed to practice-management software for healthcare providers (Angular, C#).
